scope: Stage 2 mounted routers, parameter hooks, request frames, nested alternatives and Java Pattern integration. Later methods, general error recovery, built-in transport and resource lifetime are not added to this scope.

evidence: absentOptionalDoesNotInvokeItsRegisteredHook asserts missing scalar/list accessors and zero callbacks for an optional absent capture.
scalarCacheUsesDecodedEqualityAcrossDifferentRawEncodings compares /x/%78 with swapped id positions, one hook invocation and the same transformed value in both handlers.
heldChildParameterCanExitLaterAndRestoreParentViews captures Next inside the mounted parameter hook, proves no initial commit/finish, and checks the complete before/hold/after/resume/parent trace.
The same Request is observed across the frames; later router exit skips the child route and restores parent URL/base URL while preserving the original encoded query.

malformedAndNullNestedAlternativesRejectAtomically tests a valid first path followed by nested invalid syntax or null. It checks the appropriate exception, then proves only the subsequently registered fallback runs.
The null case is explicitly labeled as the Java SRS nullness boundary, not misrepresented as an Express observation.

checks_passed: The five added tests address the three prior finding groups without weakening the original18 tests.
The existing atomic-registration guard already passes; it is correctly reported as one GREEN baseline in a23-test run with22 RED failures, not forced to fail.
Current numeric-key and wildcard-array identity expectations remain consistent with the root SRS amendments.
The new delayed mount trace agrees with the independent pinned Express probe from round1.
Advanced RegexPathPattern helper harvesting changes an earlier class-missing failure into actual registration-contract coverage; it does not claim that central registration is already implemented.
No ignored or expected-failure test is used as feature completion evidence.
